summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Self Journey Card 1 chat-style Self-Assessment v2 (iter 90, replaces iter 89's 30-question tests). Backend: 16/16 new API tests pass covering GET/PUT /me, POST /complete (422 + append + scoring + draft deletion), GET /history (sort + isolation + current_goal), POST /pdf (public + unicode + history), scoring semantics (all 3s=60, all 4s=80, section isolation). Lockstep + content-structure + scoring + PDF tests also pass (6/6). Frontend: full chat flow completed end-to-end for parent1 — overview mode renders score cards, overall 80/100, section scores all 80, 2 progress rows then 3 after new completion, first→latest deltas (60→80), central message, cycle strip, PDF download (SA_CoParents_Self_Assessment.pdf). Chat mode: 3 intro bubbles + safety note + start, typing indicator seen, progress label 'Question X of 20', 5 section dividers (child_focus/self_awareness/communication/differences/reflection), scale 1-5 answers, change-last-answer works, draft resume works on re-open after close, save-status=saved. Reflection flow with send/skip works. Goal input prefilled from 5th reflection answer. Submitting goal → results mode with sa-completion-message and confetti. door-self-goal + door-self-card-assess-last update immediately. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow. Quick Exit navigates to weather.com. All regression testids (door-quick-exit, door-safety-first, cards relationship/child-needs/foundation) present.
